source.title: Image specifications | VirtuO
source.date_note: No publication/revision date was visible on the viewed page; no time element was present. DRAFT AVAILABLE appeared in the toolbar, so this extraction concerns the normal View page and does not assert coverage of the unpublished draft.
source.owner_scope: University of Ottawa, VirtuO Brand and Design / Digital Marketing / Design; authenticated internal guidance.

schema_notes.formats: All components intend JPEG or PNG. formats_documented preserves source typos where present; formats_normalized_default is explicitly an interpretation of those typos.
schema_notes.size_caps: Null maximum_weight means not specified for that component, not unlimited and not a default 1MB. KB/MB units are preserved as printed; decimal vs binary byte convention is not given.
schema_notes.dimensions: Dimensions and aspect ratios are separately recorded source statements. Do not silently replace one with the other when they conflict. Responsive displayed crop ratios are not fixed export dimensions.
schema_notes.calculations: Any calculated ratio or mismatch commentary below is arithmetic inference, not an additional official requirement.
schema_notes.notes: Crop and usage notes are concise paraphrases of the source. Component anchors are observed DOM ids; append #anchor to canonical_url for source context.

components.name: Article hero banner - Hero image
notes: Article hero below headings/author information; upload to the hero-image slot, distinct from the author image.
Full page width at XS.
components.discrepancy: Pixel ratio approximately 1.7573:1, slightly different from 16:9.

components.name: Article hero banner - Author image

Author image placed by hero text/author information.

components.name: Article results block
notes: Image appears left of paragraph text; component only available on limited pages.

components.name: Body text with image
notes: Landscape or portrait is allowed. Every image within the same paragraph must use the same dimensions; start a new paragraph to change size.
components.ambiguity: Shape text includes Square, but explicit ratio list does not include 1:1. Do not silently add an official 1:1 option.

components.name: Business card - Image

components.name: Quick links blocks with tabs and images

components.aspect_ratio_documented: 1.6:1 at the S breakpoint; 5:4 at larger breakpoints

components.name: Quote Card

notes: Left/right image-card orientation is selectable. Card partly overlaps image; image changes with viewport. Listed export dimensions match L/XL ratio.

notes: Two related articles/funds; rectangle crops to square on smaller screens. Choose subject that tolerates crop.

notes: Introduces page-body content section; optional call to action.
